headline_seed: Live updates: Teen gunman dead after killing teachers in Thailand’s worst school shooting in years - CNN
draft_text:
#BreakingMews A 14-year-old shot and killed five people at Debsirin Nonthaburi School in Bangkok's outskirts Friday, plus his grandparents, using his grandfather's handgun. Al Jazeera and CBS News confirm he fired 26 rounds and died by suicide.

And that's the mews.
